request_payload.title: Integrated molecular and clinical analysis of low-grade gliomas in children with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1).

mentions.sentence: Low-grade gliomas (LGGs) are the most common childhood brain tumor in the general population and in individuals with the Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) cancer predisposition syndrome.
Whereas, most tumors harbored bi-allelic NF1 inactivation as the only genetic abnormality, 11% had additional mutations.
